breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and a 'Semi-implicit' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the explicit Euler instruction. The agent correctly identified the semi-implicit scheme as the intended method and did not include any mention of the conflicting explicit Euler method, thus resolving the inconsistency.
